hypothesis: Remove the shadow Mirror and use authoritative VTE ground plus partial-UTF8 state after flushing gaps. No bypass while sync is pending. No unsafe code. If a run starts inside a parser sequence, parse the run instead of speculating about where ground begins.

engine.screen: At least one of ASCII/scroll_region median CPU throughput >=1.02 with positive signs and six-workload Holm p<.05; all six paired point medians >=.98. Engine diagnostic only.

correctness: Exact built candidate: terminal suite plus 64 seeds x 200 differential streams and a deterministic chunk-boundary regression. Control uses identical added regression. Real mutant must fail the regression with actual state/cell mismatch.
follow_on: Only if screen clears, freeze fresh 30-round full-six-permutation control/candidate/Ghostty protocol and separate replication before runtime selection. No terminal timings after failed engine screen.
stop: One implementation, exactly 11 pairs, no variants or rescue pooling. Restore runtime after screen failure. Keep correct regression on restored source.
limits: Shared host; no builds during measurements, no host job termination or tuning. Best-of-five CPU is not PTY throughput, startup, key-to-screen or championship acceptance.
